title: India's tigers, 1,411 to 3,682

scenes.headline: India's tiger estimate more than doubled.
50+ years of tiger reserves
scenes.body: The 2022 count used camera traps at 32,803 locations; each tiger's stripes are unique.

scenes.headline: Still Endangered (IUCN, 2022)
scenes.body: An estimated 3,726–5,578 tigers remain in the wild worldwide.
scenes.source: IUCN Red List, Goodrich et al. 2022

caption:
From 1,411 to 3,682: the tiger estimate India's camera traps produced.

The 2022 figure is an average within a statistical range of 3,167–3,925 tigers.

Source: NTCA & WII 'Status of Tigers, Co-predators and Prey in India 2022'; IUCN Red List 2022. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Data-led conservation story with a named programme (Project Tiger) and IUCN status with year; the chart carries the story. Media thin for wild Bengal tigers (two usable photos, no wild video).
